title: Q3 2026 Budget Summary — Confidential
body: CONFIDENTIAL — Finance only. Q3 2026 budget summary: Engineering headcount spend tracking 3% under plan; Sales & Marketing spend tracking 5% over plan due to accelerated hiring against the Globex expansion opportunity; overall company spend is 1% under the annual plan through Q3. Full department-by-department breakdown is in the Finance shared drive. This document is a second example (alongside the HR-restricted docs) of a group-restricted document in the corpus, for recipes that need more than one restricted department to demonstrate ACL variety.
